name: Star Housing Finance Limited
about: Star Housing Finance Limited provides housing and non-housing loans for individuals, corporates, and developers in India. The company offers home loans for the purchase and resale of flats and houses; construction of homes on self-owned plots; renovation, extension, improvement, and repair of existing units; balance transfer; and purchase of plots for the construction of houses. It also provides top-up loans; and loans for the purchase, construction, development, and repair of commercial properties. The company was formerly known as Akme Star Housing Finance Limited and changed its name to Star Housing Finance Limited in May 2021. Star Housing Finance Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
